title: Lactobacillus Reuteri in Adult With Functional Chronic Constipation
brief_summary: A double-blind, placebo Randomized Controlled Trial, To evaluate the effects of L. reuteri in adult patients with functional constipation.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* functional constipation rome III

Exclusion Criteria:

* hypothyroidism or other metabolic or renal abnormalities, or
* antibiotic's treatment,
* probiotic or prebiotic supplementation in the last month
